specification.title: Unsupported citations fail closed before persistence
specification.description: Unsupported-citation safe failure: a schema-valid model decision citing a real corpus citation that was not supplied must fail closed before persistence. No fabricated empty result is persisted; the execution envelope records the typed error.
specification.purpose: Verify a schema-valid model decision citing a real corpus citation that was not supplied fails closed before any ResearchResult is persisted.
specification.operational_relevance: Unsupported citations would poison the epistemic chain that later reports rely on.
specification.regression_risk: The executor could persist claims whose citations were never in the supplied context.

required: The execution fails closed with an unsupported-citation error
No fabricated empty result is persisted
forbidden: A ResearchResult citing unsupplied material is persisted

query: obfuscate command-and-control traffic conceal exfiltrated data
